caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, closed color shapes, pattern equal to form, mountains patterned as dense forest, a hero on horseback thrusting a spear into a coiling dragon whose scaly body loops across a cinnabar red ground, jagged rocks and stylized trees around them, cinnabar red, malachite green, azurite blue, gold, ochre
notes_zh: Shahnama《Isfandiyar 第三关·屠龙》画幅带：龙身盘旋于赭红地，山石与纹样树。
